self_assessment: Added ErrDisabled/ErrDisabledf to errors/errors.go and made batchEvaluate detect it via errors.As and keep processing remaining flags instead of aborting the whole batch (evaluate() already populated timestamp/entity/flag fields before erroring, so the per-flag response entry is preserved); also migrated server/{evaluator,flag,rule,segment}.go from github.com/golang/protobuf to google.golang.org/protobuf (emptypb/timestamppb). Did NOT migrate storage/db/common/*.go (timestamp.go, flag.go, rule.go, segment.go still use github.com/golang/protobuf/ptypes) because a cwd-corrupting `cd` bug (see state_armA.md) broke Bash/Write/Edit partway through, before those edits landed and before `go build`/`go test` could be run at all -- this patch is UNVERIFIED by any build or test run; correctness was checked only by manual review against the pre-existing evaluator_test.go expectations (message text 'flag %q is disabled' is preserved) and by confirming golang/protobuf v1.4.3's ptypes/{empty,timestamp} packages are pure Go type aliases to the google.golang.org/protobuf types being substituted in, so the emptypb/timestamppb swap is type-safe against the still-golang/protobuf-typed generated code in rpc/flipt_grpc.pb.go.
